tools.name: check_citations
tools.description: Check that every factual item in a script is backed by a quote that appears word for word in a source text, that numbers and names in the prose appear in the quotes, and that the prose retells rather than copies. Hosted limit: 3000 characters of prose per call; for longer scripts run the local serve

tools.name: check_numbers
tools.description: List the numbers in a piece of prose that do not appear in any of the given quotes.
